subject: Final-week check: approval runway and budget for MediCore pilot?
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@medicore.com>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (MediCore pilot)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discussion and the suggested next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Goal: 3-month pilot to validate Redwood inference for real-time clinical triage (target 5–10k monthly requests).
- Success metrics: sub-200ms P95 latency for short prompts, <1.2 tokens/request cost delta vs baseline, and no PHI exfiltration.
- Key blockers you mentioned: signing a standard SOW, SOC2 attestation review, and internal procurement approval by EOW.

Next steps I proposed:
1) I’ll share a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a tailored cost projection — attached: Redwood-MAP-deck-v3.pdf.
2) Ben will follow up on SOW redlines; he’s copied.
3) You’ll surface the SOC2 artifact requests to security and confirm the approver list.

If procurement is trying to close this quarter, please flag which approver(s) are the bottleneck and whether a one-page exec summary would help.

Attachments: 20261215-medicore-discovery-notes.txt, Redwood-MAP-deck-v3.pdf

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Note: confidential internal notes attached as separate file.
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@medicore.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (MediCore pilot)

Thanks, Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear recap. Priya and I reviewed and this looks right. Procurement is on holiday rotation this week, but I expect to reengage the approvers next week. I don’t have the final list yet (Priya is pulling it).

One quick ask: can you include an explicit line-item for Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) and retention options in the SOW draft? Security will ask.

Alex
Head of Engineering, MediCore
alex.romero@medicore.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@medicore.com>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@medicore.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (MediCore pilot)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the note. I attached an initial SOW draft (SOW-draft-MediCore.docx) that includes a BYOK appendix and two retention tiers (30 / 90 days). Let me know if you want a short call next week to walk through the terms before procurement sees it.

If timeline is tight for quarter close, we can also propose a conditional kick-off clause that starts onboarding after signatures but limits initial throughput until SOC2 evidence is reviewed.

Attachments: SOW-draft-MediCore.docx

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0133
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@medicore.com>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Quick check — are approvals still on track this week? (EOQ)

Hi Alex / Priya —

I wanted to bump this thread briefly — we’re in the final business days of the quarter and I wanted to confirm whether the approval path / budget decision is still expected this week on your side. A few contextual notes that might help your approvers: 

- We can scope the pilot to a single clinical queue to reduce initial exposure and shorten review time.
- We’ll commit to the BYOK appendix and the 30-day retention tier if that accelerates procurement sign-off.
- If a signature this week is unlikely, we can still schedule a kickoff planning call in early Jan and keep the pricing/commitment window open through the first two weeks of January.

Would you share a quick heads-up on priority (green / yellow / red) for this deal and whether you need an exec summary from Stephanie to unblock?

Short replies totally fine — thanks for the time and happy holidays if you’re out.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
